blocks.text:
After breakfast, a six-hour private city tour begins, followed by a walking tour of Comuna 13.

The first stop is Pueblito Paisa, with panoramic views of the Aburrá Valley and examples of the region's traditional architecture nearby.

The route then continues through central Medellín, passing San Antonio Park, La Playa Avenue, the Coltejer building and the Prado neighbourhood.

Next, the tour moves to the redeveloped northern part of the city: the Park of Wishes, Parque Explora, the University of Antioquia and the Botanical Garden.

Continue past Punto Cero, the Atanasio Girardot sports complex, La Macarena convention centre and Plaza Mayor.

The next stretch takes you through the La Alpujarra administrative district, home to Medellín City Hall and the government of Antioquia. Along the way, you will see Liberty Square, Parque de las Luces and the Public Utilities Library.

The final part of the driving route passes through El Poblado, including El Poblado Park, Lleras Park and the Golden Mile.

Then take a walking tour of Comuna 13 with a local guide.

Once considered one of the city's most dangerous neighbourhoods, it is now known for graffiti, street art and its system of escalators. As you walk through the narrow streets and stairways, your guide explains the neighbourhood's history and transformation.

Private transport, an English-speaking guide, a local guide in Comuna 13, stops at Pueblito Paisa and key areas of urban transformation, and a local medical assistance card are included.

Lunch and dinner are at an additional cost.
